Imagine yourself gliding effortlessly along without any distractions. You’re blissfully at peace – one with the road. Helping you
connect with this feeling is the driving force behind every aspect of Continental, including the way it handles. Lincoln Drive Control
with Continuously Controlled Damping helps isolate your vehicle from the road’s imperfections, while adaptive steering delivers
impressive steering responsiveness and performance. This is the effortless driving experience you’ve dreamed of.
2017 LINCOLN CONTINENTAL
Learn more about these empowering technologies in the Specifications. Lincoln.com

--- page 18 ---
SO MUCH CAN HAPPEN IN THE BLINK OF AN EYE.
You can make an impression. Stir up emotions. Completely change your course. When split-second challenges arise on the road,
the advanced driver-assist features1 Continental offers in its Technology Package can help you maintain a sense of calm.
Enabling the vehicle to monitor your surroundings so you can react accordingly, these features provide support in many ways. They can
help detect the presence of other vehicles in your blind spots and prompt you to stay in your lane. They can help manage the vehicle’s
speed in tedious stop-and-go traffic, as well as on the open highway. And if you should need to come to an unanticipated stop, there are
technologies engineered to help with that, too.1 Glide through life’s experiences with elegant confidence in the all-new Lincoln Continental.
2017 LINCOLN CONTINENTAL
Learn more about these advanced technologies in the Specifications. 1Driver-assist features are supplemental and do not replace the driver’s attention, judgment and need to control the vehicle. Lincoln.com
